Merging of the Cantonese rising tones

Source: R/data.R
cantonese_tone_merger.Rd

Hong Kong Cantonese has two rising tones, T2 (high rising, 25) and T5 (low rising, 23), which some younger speakers merge. 90 speakers, half aged 18 to 25 and half 26 to 74, each produce 10 T2 and 10 T5 words; the size of the f0 rise is measured in semitones. For a sound change in apparent time and for individual differences: mergers form a small, separate group of speakers, most of them young.

Usage

cantonese_tone_merger

Format

A tibble with 1800 rows and 7 columns:

speaker

S01 to S90.

age

Age in years.

gender

"female" or "male".

word

w01 to w20.

tone

"T2" or "T5".

log_freq

log10 word frequency, 1 to 5; no effect.

rise

f0 rise from onset to offset in semitones.

Source

data-raw/cantonese_tone_merger.R

Details

True model: each speaker is a merger with probability 0.22 * plogis((30 - age) / 4), about 0.2 for speakers under 25. Non-mergers rise by 7 semitones in T2 and 3.5 in T5; mergers by 5.4 and 5.0, so they keep a small difference. By-speaker intercepts have SD 0.6 and token SD is 0.9; word frequency and gender have no effect. Mok, Zuo and Wong (2013) judged 28 of 169 students aged 18 to 22 to merge tones. Their mergers still kept T2 and T5 slightly apart, and neither word frequency nor gender made a difference. Because all their speakers were young, the decline of merging with age is a design choice, and the values and data are simulated.

References

Mok, P. P. K., Zuo, D. & Wong, P. W. Y. (2013). Production and perception of a sound change in progress: Tone merging in Hong Kong Cantonese. Language Variation and Change, 25(3), 341-370. doi:10.1017/S0954394513000161

Examples

rise <- tapply(cantonese_tone_merger$rise,
               cantonese_tone_merger[c("speaker", "tone")], mean)
age <- tapply(cantonese_tone_merger$age, cantonese_tone_merger$speaker, unique)
difference <- rise[, "T2"] - rise[, "T5"]
hist(difference, breaks = 20)

plot(age, difference)

table(merger = difference < 2, under_40 = age < 40)
#>        under_40
#> merger  FALSE TRUE
#>   FALSE    28   53
#>   TRUE      0    9
